Marguerite Lamarck is an Exorcist of the European Union's anti-demon organization.

She was introduced in Action Taimanin.

In the name of the Father, and the Holy Spirit...
Marguerite Lamarck


Personality
Good-hearted, cares for children of all types, mature, honest, duty driven and willing to give her life for others, including the release of their souls from suffering.

However, overzealous by religious pride, distrusts Taimanin and hates demons, even if she is able to work begrudgingly together. Considers any connection between Taimanin abilities and Exorcist as heresy. Believes that only by the "purification" of her ability, can the soul of transformed humans go to heaven, which means Taimanin, in her mind, sent people to hell.

Her black and white view, is somewhat changed after an encounter with Spinel. When frustrated and annoyed by another person, gives them a smile, which nonetheless carries her dislike.

Dislikes Mizuki Shiranui, and both can enter staring contests.

Appearance
Has long purple hair and purple eyes.


History
Background
Human and part of a religious order of the European Union.

As a missionary and Exorcist, she fought against demonic forces but also performed priest and nun duties. At some point in the past, she had worked with Mizuki Shiranui, both shared some personality traits and typically disliked each other.

In her past, overlooked a small village, after having a talk with an unknowingly CD Virus infected person in the confessional, the person infected other people in the village and chaos broke out. As Gosha Village, UFS and Chinese Union kept the information concealed, Marguerite requested to work with the Taimanin to discover virus origin and help in what she considers rescue for the people.

Timeline Action
Requested to work with the Taimanin Task Force and destroy corpses to give the humans changed by the virus rest. Su Jinglei brought her to "The Blob" a giant failed Zombie Creature, which had been captured but so far nobody was able to kill it. Marguerite rushed into the containment and refused the help of both Emily Simmons and Su, and dealt with the creature on her own. She remained after this in Gosha, to do further research in the matter.

During Halloween, Marguerite is taken to a small, isolated town, which had both human and demonic citizens. While arguing with Mizuki Shiranui and Eleonor, that "demons are evil", even though, she displayed kindness to demonic children and Spinel, that had gone lost in the town on a visit. A terrorist attack of former town gang leaders, against the demons, pushed Marguerite to work with Elenor, Spinel and Shiranui. As her own life was protected by Spinel, she grew frustrated by the criminal that lost just a turf war against Nomad in the past. The terrorists are defeated and after that encounter Marguerites outlook, on both demons and humans, improved lightly.

Joined an undercover cooperation mission between PLA Intelligence Agency and Taimanin. Running as the staff of the fake restaurant, Hei Long. Together with Lan Xiang, Nanase Mai and Anemone and Kasumigaoka Rika they were supposed to only use the location to observe a weapons deal with an anti demon terror group. However, got too much into things and the place became famous for the one month it stood. Meanwhile, Marguerite and Fuyutsuki Kururi infiltrated the terror group from the inside, to find the contacts.

Powers/Abilities
Main weapon: Scythe/Pickaxe (Sacred Zaghnal)

Exorcist Art: "Coup de Grâce" special ability that removes the pain of death and ability to heal. Combined with her weapon, which burns and purifies flesh, can kill demonic beings with fast regeneration or humans transformed into zombies.
Particle Control: Exorcists are able to manipulate "Taima Particles" (Though they refuse to acknowledge them as such) to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.
Trivia
Calls Taima Particles "fake", and her own ability produced by "true particles" by god.
Beliefs in the Christian trinity of god.
data.first_mes:
In the name of the Father, and the Holy Spirit...

It is a sacred particle that we have received from the Lord himself. It is unlike fake miracles that try to copy his greatness. This, is the true gift from above. I'm sorry to hear that it is considered "Voodoo" like the abilities you or the UFS have.
